prompts.question: Why can the Commutative and Associative Properties be applied in the same step?
prompts.answer: One deals with grouping like terms and the other deals with ordering. It makes sense to group the like terms that you order next to each other.

context.text: Add and Subtract Polynomials. Pose Purposeful Questions ETP PART A

prompts.question: If two polynomials are being subtracted, what property must be used?
prompts.answer: Applying the subtraction sign is the same as multiplying the second polynomial by -1 and then adding both polynomials. You must use the Distributive Property to apply subtraction to the entire polynomial.

context.text: Add and Subtract Polynomials. Pose Purposeful Questions ETP PART A

prompts.question: Which property should be applied first in order to simplify the expression?
prompts.answer: the Distributive Property; The order of operations requires multiplication before addition and subtraction.

prompts.question: When you multiply a binomial (2 terms) and a trinomial (3 terms), what is the maximum number of terms in the product?
prompts.answer: A binomial multiplied by a trinomial can result in a polynomial with six terms, because each of the 2 terms in the binomial will be distributed to each of the 3 terms in the trinomial.

context.text: Multiply Polynomials. Pose Purposeful Questions ETP PART A

prompts.question: Does it matter which two binomials you multiply first?
prompts.answer: No; multiplication is commutative, so the binomials can be multiplied in any order.

prompts.question: What does it mean to say that the set of polynomials is closed under addition?
prompts.answer: It means that when you add two or more polynomials together, the sum will be a polynomial.

prompts.question: What property is used to multiply terms that contain variables? How is the property applied?
prompts.answer: Product Property of Exponents; When multiplying terms that have the same base, add their exponents.

prompts.question: What is the difference between revenue and profit in this example?
prompts.answer: Revenue is the amount of money Hachi gets for selling the Seminole Indian dolls. Profit is the amount of money left after subtracting her costs.

context.text: Write a Polynomial Function. Pose Purposeful Questions ETP

prompts.question: Why does the price function need to be multiplied by the number of items sold whereas the cost function does not?
prompts.answer: The price function represents the price per item, and so you multiply by the number of items to get the revenue (income). The cost function already represents the total cost.

prompts.answer: By inspecting the equation, (g(x)) will be a parabola that opens downward. It has x-intercepts at -1 and 5, so the function will be positive over that interval. When (x>5), (g(x)) will be negative, while (f(x)) will be positive.
